<infobox>
	<title source="title">
    	<default>{{PAGENAME}}</default>
	</title>
	<image source="image">
		<default>Placeholder.png</default>
	</image>
	<header>Event Information</header>
	<group layout="horizontal">
		<data source="previous_event">
    		<label><div>Previous Event</div></label>
    		<default><span style="color: gray;">''???''</span></default>
    	</data>
		<data source="next_event">
    		<label><div>Next Event</div></label>
    		<default><span style="color: gray;">''???''</span></default>
    	</data>
    </group>
     <data source="timeline">
    	<label><div>Timeline</div></label>
    </data>
        <data source="rewards">
    	<label><div>Rewards</div></label>
    </data>
    <data source="entities">
    	<label><div>Entities</div></label>
    </data>
</infobox>
<noinclude>{{Documentation}}</noinclude>

<noinclude>
Example usage:
{{SectionInfoBox
  | title1=Example
  | image1=Example.jpg
  | caption-image1=Example
  | row1=Example
  | row2=Example}}
<pre>
{{SectionInfoBox
  | title1=Example
  | image1=Example.jpg
  | caption-image1=Example
  | row1=Example
  | row2=Example}}
</pre>

</noinclude>
